Added plugin deletion functionality: 'plugin -delete <name>' now removes the specified plugin file from the plugins directory and updates the active plugins list.
Fixed critical bug where plugins were discovered but never loaded: the loadPlugins() function body was empty, so the activePlugins array stayed empty and no plugin commands were registered.
Implemented full plugin loading logic: reads .js files from ~/.tridev/plugins/, validates each plugin exports a 'name' and 'execute' function, and registers them for command dispatch.
Added automatic autocomplete and syntax highlighting support for loaded plugins by dynamically registering plugin names into COMMANDS and their subcommands into SUBCOMMANDS.
Resolved module resolution failure for external plugins by injecting the shell's node_modules path via NODE_PATH and Module._initPaths(), allowing plugins to use shell dependencies like chalk.

Refactored the admin command to have a built in json instead of a seperate generated file for easier scaling
Fixed update launch timing so the shell exits before the PowerShell updater downloads the new binary, preventing file overwrite conflicts.
Resolved a version parsing bug in the update checker and improved numeric version comparison for 5.1.x releases.

The version check now checks versions in a undotted, joined format, to avoid newer versions to be detected as older than the current version. For example, before the check thought that 5.1.10 was older than 5.1.1, because it compared the strings and 1 is smaller than 10, but now it compares them as numbers, so 510 is newer than 511.

Changed the ai command once again. Fixed previous bug where no ai models where seen by the shell in some cases.

Reason: Sometimes ollama server were not running on the users device, so the shell couldd't get the models, and that's why it worked after a download. Fix: after using an ai command the shell automatically runs a check whether the server is running or no, and if not than starts it.
